headlines.label: Overtakes
headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: ALO (5)

summary: George Russell won the Singapore Grand Prix from pole position, 5.4s ahead of Max Verstappen, with Lando Norris completing the podium.
Carlos Sainz made the biggest climb, from P18 to P10.
Nico Hulkenberg had a day to forget, dropping from P11 to P20.
There were 23 pit stops in total; the winner stopped once.
Rain fell at some point during the race.
Oscar Piastri leads the championship by 22 points over Lando Norris.
